title: Error and bang-bang
summary: The difference between want and have, and on/off control.

steps.title: Error
steps.say: Every controller starts here: how far are we from the target?

steps.title: Bang-bang
steps.say: Too slow? Full power. Fast enough? Nothing.

board.caption: Fast to spin up, but it slams the motor on and off.

steps.title: Open ShooterSubsystem.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `ShooterSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find bangBang
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+F**, search for `bangBang`, and write it. Then set `FLYWHEEL_CONTROL = BANG_BANG` in ShooterConstants.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Watch it wobble
steps.say: Hold **U**. Look closely around the target. In AdvantageScope, search for `FlywheelVelocity`, then drag **Subsystem/Shooter/FlywheelVelocity** onto the **Left Axis**.
